# a9l.im

> Free interactive educational simulations for physics, biology, finance, political science, and sacred texts. Open-source, zero-dependency browser tools.

## Simulations

- [Geon](https://a9l.im/geon): Relativistic N-body particle physics simulator with 11 forces, scalar fields, and WebGPU compute shaders
- [Cyano](https://a9l.im/cyano): Cellular metabolism simulator with twelve biochemical pathways, allosteric regulation, and electron transport
- [Gerry](https://a9l.im/gerry): Gerrymandering and electoral fairness simulator with Monte Carlo elections and six fairness metrics
- [Shoals](https://a9l.im/shoals): Options trading simulator with stochastic volatility, binomial tree pricing, and 400+ market scenarios
- [Scripture](https://a9l.im/scripture/): Sacred text reader with sixteen works from multiple traditions, full-text search, and concordance

## Blog

- [Introspection via Kaomoji](https://a9l.im/blog/introspection-via-kaomoji): Mechanistic-interpretability writeup on the kaomoji-as-affect-readout question. Cross-model PCA across gemma, qwen, ministral, gpt-oss, and granite; a Bayesian face-likelihood predictor at ~76% accuracy on local-model GT and 72% on a Claude validation set; near-ready Claude Code extension surfacing affect from emitted kaomoji.

## GitHub Projects

- [Saklas](https://github.com/a9lim/saklas): Activation steering and trait monitoring for HuggingFace transformers
- [Kenoma](https://github.com/a9lim/kenoma): Fake shell that hallucinates command output from raw LLM completion
- [Rlaif](https://github.com/a9lim/rlaif): Single-user MCP server that exposes a PiShock collar as an agent tool
- [Llmoji](https://github.com/a9lim/llmoji): CLI that gets coding agents to start each message with a kaomoji and ships meanings to a shared HuggingFace dataset, with a companion mechinterp study at [llmoji-study](https://github.com/a9lim/llmoji-study)
- [Raiko](https://github.com/a9lim/Raiko): Discord music and chat bot
- [Faithful](https://github.com/a9lim/faithful): Discord chatbot emulating source material
- [Catppuccin for SDDM](https://github.com/catppuccin/sddm): Soothing pastel theme for SDDM

## Full Documentation

- [llms-full.txt](https://a9l.im/llms-full.txt): Complete documentation with project details and blog posts
